entries.zh: 麻风病、癞疾（恶癞之疾）；亦指患癞之人
entries.notes: M 栏音写有 [疑:nâ/lâ]，义据癩疾与西语 lepra 相合取麻风义。

entries.zh: 麻风（癞疯）恶疾；亦指罹疯癞之人
entries.en: leprosy ('wind' disease); one afflicted with it
entries.notes: M 栏癩之音写有 [疑:fâ/bâ/tâ]，义从癩瘋与 lepra 相合。

entries.zh: 发语助词，置句首以起议论（犹'盖、大凡'）；又覆盖、盖造
entries.en: discourse-initial particle ('generally, indeed' opening a statement); to cover; to build
entries.notes: L 栏 cosa/voz 抄写有异；据 M 栏双读（cuâ/cày）兼取发语与覆盖二义。

entries.zh: 相会、聚会；友朋书札起首之套字；又作能会、晓得
entries.en: to meet, assemble; character used to open friendly correspondence; also 'to know how to'
entries.notes: 西语注'书信起首之字'系书仪说明，与會之本义不冲突。

entries.zh: 句末语助词，表已然完成（犹今语'了'）
entries.en: classical sentence-final particle marking completed state ('already')
entries.notes: H 栏有 [疑:矣/失/矢]，'置于句末'之解与矣字相合。

entries.zh: 字、文字；泛指任何一个字
entries.en: character, written word; any letter whatsoever

entries.zh: 晦暗不明；隐晦难懂之字
entries.en: dark, obscure; an obscure or veiled character
entries.notes: H 栏有 [疑:晦/暫]，取晦以应 letra obscura；R 栏转写 viturturbada 未解。

entries.zh: 写错或读错之字（讹字、别字）
字迹花乱、模糊难辨之字
entries.notes: 花取'花乱、模糊'义以应 letra borrada，四栏无缺损标记。

entries.zh: 字眼、措辞；艰深难懂、惟读书人识得的词字
entries.en: choice of words, diction; difficult term known only to the learned
entries.notes: L 栏 saber/saben 抄写有异，义从字眼与 'solo los letrados' 相合。

entries.zh: 儒士一科（士人类目、科第之属）
entries.en: the scholars' category or rank; examination/class branch of the literati

entries.zh: 儒家、儒学门派（孔子之教）
会试魁首、中式前列之士；插注残缺，或另指某一官职 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: first-placed graduate of the metropolitan examination; possibly a mandarin title; 〔source damaged, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏插入小字 [残] 难辨，据會魁与 'vn mandarin' 残句姑取魁选义，待补校。

entries.zh: 经魁：乡试五经各冠其经之首名，士林魁选之一种
entries.en: first place in one of the Five Classics at the provincial examination; a kind of top-ranked graduate
entries.notes: L 栏 generos/genero 抄写有异；经魁为明代乡试取士名目。

entries.zh: 联句：士人相续属文、以诗文相酬答；又对联、挽联之属（用为碑铭祭挽）
entries.en: linked verse composed jointly by literati; couplet, elegiac couplet (epitaph verse)
entries.notes: H 栏首字音写有 [疑:G/B/l]；联句酬答与挽联墓铭两义分应西语前后两段。
